task: Elevate the existing Control Plane with risk-based assurance ceiling, specialist dissent, PO-derived completion contracts, evidence freshness, completion integrity and read-only truth verification without parallel authorities.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This change modifies the development and release decision system itself. Use exhaustive deterministic state/evidence scenarios and fault injection, but avoid full formal verification because the core is finite repository/CI orchestration rather than a high-dimensional concurrent business protocol.

deferredTechniques.reason: Finite exhaustive evidence-state matrices provide stronger and cheaper coverage for this deterministic evaluator.
Disproportionate cost for deterministic repository/CI orchestration with bounded states and no critical concurrent business mutation.

acceptanceCriteria: Pre-execution planning determines and validates a risk-based assurance ceiling.
Medium-or-higher work models failure states, compares alternatives and records adversarial challenge.
At least one relevant specialist acts as dissent and cannot self-certify unresolved findings.
Completion Contract is traced to the PO request rather than derived from implementation steps.
A read-only Truth Gate maps completion claims to exact-state evidence and never treats missing evidence as DONE.
Evidence is stale when source commit or branch identity no longer matches the evaluated exact state.
Learning from preventable misses feeds the existing Failure Intake and Known Failure authority instead of creating per-defect gates.
Existing Atlas, Sentinel, Knowledge, Replay, Release Risk and Template Factory authorities are reused rather than duplicated.
invariants: No parallel Control Plane, Atlas, Sentinel, Failure Intake or release authority is created.
Execution authorization requires a valid pre-execution plan envelope.
Exactly one implementation alternative is selected after challenge.
Critical work has at least one dissent specialist and no unresolved challenge finding.
CLAIM WITHOUT EVIDENCE remains NOT VERIFIED.
DONE requires every Completion Contract requirement and negative regression claim to be freshly evidenced at exact state.
Truth evaluation is read-only and cannot merge, deploy, update goldens or weaken gates.

alternatives.summary: Create a new top-level orchestrator plus separate planning, challenge and completion gate families.
alternatives.reason: Duplicates authority boundaries and increases bureaucracy and drift.

alternatives.summary: Extend the existing Development Guard and Plan Before Code contract and add one read-only completion evaluator consuming existing gate evidence.
alternatives.reason: Provides the requested assurance lifecycle with the smallest blast radius and reuses existing authorities.

alternatives.summary: Document the process only and rely on agent discipline without machine enforcement.
alternatives.reason: Cannot prevent incomplete plans or unsupported DONE claims deterministically.

specialistReviews.finding: Reuse the existing authority graph and Development Guard; no new parallel control authority.
A Truth Gate could become a second release authority or certify stale cross-workflow evidence.
specialistReviews.resolution: Truth Gate is read-only completion integrity under quality authority; Release Risk remains release authority and evidence is exact-state bound.

specialistReviews.finding: New completion failures must flow into the existing Failure Intake and learning loop.
specialistReviews.resolution: Truth diagnostics are consumed by existing Failure Intake; no second incident ledger.

specialistReviews.finding: Critical-depth process must not impose the same overhead on trivial edits.
specialistReviews.resolution: Policy enforces risk-based depth with a lightweight low-risk path.

challenge.scenario: A requirement is omitted from the implementation plan.
challenge.resolution: Completion Contract is a separate PO-source field and Truth Gate evaluates it directly.

challenge.scenario: HEAD changes after a green proof.
challenge.resolution: Every evidence item is bound to exact source commit and branch; mismatch is STALE_EVIDENCE.

challenge.scenario: A required guard outcome is absent.
challenge.finding: Missing evidence could be mistaken for success.
challenge.resolution: Missing evidence yields PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and PO status NOT DONE.

challenge.finding: Completion could still appear partially green.
challenge.resolution: Failed evidence yields NOT_DONE; blocked infrastructure yields BLOCKED.

challenge.scenario: A plan validates itself without opposition.
challenge.resolution: Medium, high and critical plans require a dissent specialist; critical requires multiple relevant reviews.
Risk-depth thresholds reduce required modeling, challenge and specialist counts for lower tiers.

challenge.scenario: Truth evaluation becomes a second release authority.
challenge.resolution: Completion integrity is owned by existing quality authority; Release Risk remains release authority.

challenge.scenario: A later preventable defect is merely patched.
challenge.resolution: Failure Intake records a learning review and routes prevention to existing authorities.

challenge.scenario: Truth evaluation is retried or duplicated.
challenge.finding: A mutable evaluator could create side effects.
challenge.resolution: Truth Gate is read-only and artifact-only; repeated runs cannot mutate product or release state.

challenge.scenario: A forbidden regression is not explicitly checked.
challenge.finding: Functional success could hide a prohibited side effect.
challenge.resolution: Completion requirements carry negative-regression evidence refs and Truth Gate requires those proofs too.

proofPlan: Exhaustive finite-state tests for PASS, FAIL, MISSING, STALE and BLOCKED evidence combinations.
Regression tests for risk-depth thresholds and dissent requirements.
Regression tests that Completion Contract is PO-sourced and requirement IDs are unique.
Regression tests that Truth Gate cannot return VERIFIED_DONE with missing, stale or failed evidence.
CI wiring in the existing workflow only; no new workflow authority.
Failure Intake regression proving missed-thinking learning metadata is retained.

requirements.requirement: Determine a maximum practical assurance ceiling before serious implementation and scale depth by risk.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Low-risk work must not be forced through critical-depth ceremony.

requirements.requirement: Enforce OBSERVE through LEARN as the canonical operational sequence without creating parallel authorities.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No parallel Control Plane, Atlas, Sentinel or release authority.

requirements.requirement: Require relevant specialist review with at least one explicit dissent role for non-low-risk plans.
Create a machine-checkable Completion Contract from the PO request, independent from the implementation plan.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Implementation steps cannot substitute for missing PO requirements.

requirements.requirement: Add a read-only Truth Gate that verifies requirement, implementation, outcome and negative claims using fresh evidence.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Claim without evidence cannot become DONE.

requirements.requirement: Bind completion evidence to exact SHA, branch, state or version and run or timestamp; stale evidence cannot prove DONE.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Changed HEAD invalidates older critical evidence.

requirements.requirement: Expose internal VERIFIED DONE, PARTIALLY VERIFIED, NOT DONE, BLOCKED and STALE EVIDENCE while keeping PO status to DONE, NOT DONE or BLOCKED plus NEXT.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: PARTIALLY VERIFIED must never map to DONE.

requirements.requirement: Route preventable missed-thinking defects back through existing Failure Intake and Known Failure learning instead of creating a gate per defect.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No per-defect parallel gate or incident ledger.

requirements.requirement: Reuse existing Atlas, Sentinel, Knowledge, Development Guard, A/B Reference Sync, Replay, Release Risk, Template Factory and CI authorities.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Existing blocking semantics and authority ownership are not weakened.

requirements.requirement: Implement the capability with minimum new infrastructure and verify the current exact branch state before closure.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: MAIN merge, golden update and gate weakening are not side effects of this development transaction.

notes: Critical Control Plane self-development. Extend existing Development Guard and Plan Before Code, consume existing CI evidence, add one read-only completion-integrity evaluator, and route learning through existing Failure Intake. No main merge, no golden update, no gate weakening.
